Good veggie meal!
Feb 2023 • Friends
It was nice to find a vegetarian version of a traditional Dish! The Mushroom pho was very nice and a good portion. My friend had the Tofu and rice. Mushrooms were really tasted but the tofu could of been more flavoursome. We also had summer rolls (18k VND)

Our total bill came to 190k VND (just under £8.

The restaurant is upstairs through another restaurant so a little tricky to find. It does also close early than most places at 9pm.
